cashPaid.label: Cash paid
cashPaid.definition: Amounts actually paid, as recorded. Energy estimated for distance without drive data is included and always named.

economicCost.label: Economic cost
economicCost.definition: Costs spread over the period they cover instead of the day they were paid.

fullCost.label: Full cost
fullCost.definition: The economic cost plus depreciation: what owning the vehicle really costs.

runningCost.label: Running cost
runningCost.definition: Energy or fuel, tolls and parking only.

atTheWheel.label: Consumption at the wheel
atTheWheel.definition: Energy used while driving, as measured by the vehicle.

atThePlug.label: Consumption at the plug
atThePlug.definition: Energy drawn when charging, losses included, over the distance driven.

estimatedEnergy.label: Estimated energy
estimatedEnergy.definition: Energy priced for distance driven without drive data, from the vehicle average consumption and price.

chargeEfficiency.label: Charging efficiency
chargeEfficiency.definition: Energy stored in the battery over energy drawn from the grid.

fullChargeCost.label: Cost of a full charge
fullChargeCost.definition: Extrapolated from the charges whose cost and battery level are known.

smoothedMonthlyCost.label: 12-month average
smoothedMonthlyCost.definition: What a month costs on average over the last twelve months, the current one included. Over a shorter history it averages the months there are.

currencyPerVehicle.label: Currency
currencyPerVehicle.definition: Currency is set per vehicle when it is created (Vehicles page); it is not an account setting.

passwordSignOut.label: Password change
passwordSignOut.definition: Other devices are signed out after a password change.

signedOutDevice.label: Signing a device out
signedOutDevice.definition: A signed-out device keeps its access for up to 15 minutes, the lifetime of the access token.

monthBars.label: Monthly chart
monthBars.definition: Click or tap a bar of the chart to open the month's detailed figures.

donutFull.label: Full cost
donutFull.definition: Economic cost: tire wear spread over use, depreciation included.

donutCash.label: Cash paid
donutCash.definition: Money actually paid: tires when bought, no depreciation.
